title: Joong-Gun

symbol.name: Joong-Gun
symbol.meaning: The patriot An Jung-geun · ITF pattern 6 of 24

note.p: Joong-Gun is named after the patriot An Jung-geun, who shot Ito Hirobumi, the first Japanese resident-general of Korea. The 32 movements stand for his age when he was executed in Lushun prison in 1910. The diagram is I. You start feet together in the middle of the A–B line facing D: reverse knife-hand blocks, low side kicks and upward palm blocks to B and A; guarding blocks, upper elbow strikes and twin-fist punches down the stem; back fists, releases and high punches to E and F; then back up toward C with double forearm blocks, punches and side kicks, slow palm pressing blocks, a slow angle punch, and two U-shape blocks where you began.

footer: Move numbers follow the ITF Encyclopedia count (32 movements, one technique each). Directions use the ITF letters: you start facing D, with B on your left and A on your right; E and F are the ends of the far line. Finish by bringing the left foot back to close ready stance B.

moves.desc: Stand at the centre of the A–B line facing D in close ready stance B: feet together, the left hand wrapped over the right fist in front of the abdomen.
Turn left: move the left foot to B into a right L-stance facing B (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left reverse knife-hand middle block.
Left low side front snap kick toward B, the hands held where they were.
Land the left foot toward B, then step the right foot forward into a left rear foot stance facing B (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right palm upward block.
Move the right foot to A into a left L-stance facing A (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right reverse knife-hand middle block.
Right low side front snap kick toward A, the hands held where they were.
Land the right foot toward A, then step the left foot forward into a right rear foot stance facing A (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left palm upward block.
Turn left: move the left foot to D into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Slip the left foot forward toward D into a left walking stance. Right upper elbow strike.
Step the right foot forward toward D into a left L-stance (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Slip the right foot forward toward D into a right walking stance. Left upper elbow strike.
Step the left foot forward toward D into a left walking stance. Twin fist high vertical punch.
Step the right foot forward toward D into a right walking stance. Twin fist upset punch, with a kihap.
Move the right foot onto the C–D line, then turn counter-clockwise into a left walking stance facing C. X-fist rising block.
Turn left: move the left foot to E into a right L-stance facing E (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left back fist high side strike.
Twist the left fist until the back of the fist faces down, slipping the left foot forward toward E into a left walking stance: release from a grab.
In the same stance, right high punch, fast after 15.
Bring the left foot to the right foot, then move the right foot to F into a left L-stance facing F (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right back fist high side strike.
Twist the right fist until the back of the fist faces down, slipping the right foot forward toward F into a right walking stance: release from a grab.
In the same stance, left high punch, fast after 18.
Bring the right foot to the left foot, then move the left foot toward C into a left walking stance facing C. Left double forearm high block, the right fist bracing the left arm.
Pull the left foot back into a right L-stance facing C (left foot still forward). Left middle punch.
Right middle side piercing kick toward C.
Set the right foot down toward C into a right walking stance. Right double forearm high block, the left fist bracing the right arm.
Pull the right foot back into a left L-stance facing C (right foot still forward). Right middle punch.
Left middle side piercing kick toward C.
Set the left foot down toward C into a right L-stance (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Forearm middle guarding block.
Slip the left foot forward toward C into a left low stance. Right palm pressing block, slowly.
Step the right foot forward toward C into a left L-stance (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Forearm middle guarding block.
Slip the right foot forward toward C into a right low stance. Left palm pressing block, slowly.
Bring the left foot to the right foot into a closed stance facing A. Right angle punch, slowly.
Move the right foot to A into a right fixed stance facing A. U-shape block.
Bring the right foot to the left foot, then move the left foot to B into a left fixed stance facing B. U-shape block.
